example_sentences_in_bangla: অসুখে ভুগতে ভুগতে সে কমজোর হয়ে পড়েছে।
দীর্ঘ যাত্রার পর তার শরীর কমজোরি অনুভব করছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He has become weak after suffering from illness.
His body feels frail after the long journey.
note: This idiom is commonly used in colloquial Bengali to describe physical debility, often linked to health issues.
